code.description:
The problem code of its error (`SH1002`), or of its failure when
it ran and failed on the setup (`doctor`); `shuyi explain <code>`
prints its page.

error.description: Why it could not run, if it could not.

help.description: How to fix it, with the code.

limits.description: What it could not determine, in plain words.

ok.description:
Whether it passed: nothing found by a check, runs that agree, a
game made, a toolchain complete. False too when it could not run.

result.description: What it found or made; absent when it could not run.

oneOf.description:
The engine: the folder, the name, the id, the perspectives and the
targets.
The catalog, `docs/modules.ron`: one question per concern.

id.description: Its id, as its flag takes it (`top-down-grid`).

status.description:
Whether it is built: only a `ready` answer is picked, and a
`planned` or `parked` one is shown as coming (ADR-0013 §6).

text.description: A few words that say it (`top-down grid`).

tickets.description: The tickets that build it, if it isn't ready.

agent.description:
What an agent asking for its user must do with it, if it must do
more than ask: `github`'s says an agent never answers `yes` itself.

answers.description: The answers it offers, every one with its status; none for text.

default.description:
What it takes unless another answer is given: the answers given so
far, else its default (for text, the one line).

flag.description:
The flag that answers it (`--bodies`, `--set examples=`); none for
the folder, `new`'s first word.

id.description:
Its id: the engine's (`dir`, `name`, `id`, `perspective`,
`targets`), a concern's (`bodies`) or the template's
(`private-files`).

skipped.description: Why it isn't asked, if it isn't: it takes its default.

Questions.description: The questions `shuyi new` asks of a game, for the answers given so far.

questions.description: Every question, in the order it is asked.

Status.description: Whether an answer or a module is built.

oneOf.description: Built, with an example passing CI.
Not started until the plan says.
One of its answers at most.
